R3 Existence(target_picked_up) with R2 Precedence(has_door_key, target_picked_up) captures 'Then pick up the box': the box is required and may not precede taking the key. The redundancy listing on R1 is fine — that clause is stated by the task's 'if' sentence, so it stays.
